title: Reported waste destination versus actual handling authority
initial_observation: IF a TRI sender reports a chemical/year transfer to a specifically identified off-site receiver under a disposal, treatment, energy-recovery or recycling code.
expected_observation: THEN resolve the actual receiving operation and compare the reported handling route with its historical permit/authorization and shipment evidence for the same waste, process and interval.
possible_finding_and_basis: A verified incompatible destination or management account can expose a waste oversight gap; a transfer is not necessarily a release or a hazardous waste.
operational_join: Sender TRIFID is not the receiver RCRA ID. Use the reported receiver identifier/address, validate the receiving site rather than a broker, and crosswalk chemical to actual regulated waste/process evidence.
temporal_geographic_scope: US domestic routes with identifiable receiver; annual TRI totals may span permit changes, so dated shipment evidence is mandatory for event timing.
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Current permit status differs from historic authorization
mandatory_evidence: Form R transfer record and revisions
Historical receiver site/permit and applicable waste classification
Dated manifests/receipts or equivalent transfer evidence
next_cheapest_check: Inspect the transfer fields and one historical permit scope before considering any allegation; absence of a RCRA permit by itself is disqualifying as an illegality inference.
novelty_vs_baseline: C01 compares emissions estimates; C02/C05 are spatial exposure. This follows the sender-to-receiver waste-management chain and its permitted process.
access_status: Current sender guidance and receiver modules documented; no permit, manifest or transfer record sampled. No bulk RCRA files downloaded.

title: A synthesis treating overlapping participants as independent evidence
initial_observation: IF a review or meta-analysis treats two papers as independent study populations, and explicit trial references suggest their enrolled cohorts may overlap.
expected_observation: THEN reconstruct cohorts, arms, recruitment intervals and outcomes from registry history and full papers, and determine whether the synthesis double-counts the same participants for the same comparison.
possible_finding_and_basis: Inflated independent evidence can alter treatment or policy conclusions. Multiple papers from one trial are ordinary and not misconduct when handled correctly.
operational_join: DOI references → explicit NCT/protocol IDs → cohort/arm/recruitment overlap → synthesis study rows. One NCT is not automatically one identical participant set.
temporal_geographic_scope: Matched trial versions and actual synthesis analysis; repeated follow-up, platform trials and subgroup populations need explicit handling.
mandatory_evidence: Full synthesis methods and included-study table
next_cheapest_check: Read the synthesis’s exact inclusion rows and the papers’ cohort descriptions before counting shared trial IDs as duplicate evidence.
novelty_vs_baseline: H02 compares prespecified outcomes and P01 checks retractions. This tests independence of the evidence units used in a synthesis.
access_status: Registry and DOI metadata routes documented earlier; full texts/cohort records and synthesis calculation not tested.

title: Direct industry payments versus an explicit article disclosure

Window, relevance or policy excludes the relationship

title: Fixed extractive-contract obligation versus covered receipts
initial_observation: IF the operative original contract fixes a particular annual rent, community contribution or guaranteed minimum due for one project/payer/payee and period, and the payment trigger is evidenced.
expected_observation: THEN compare that exact obligation with a demonstrably complete matching receipt stream, reconciling any payer disclosure and authorized amendment before describing a shortfall.
possible_finding_and_basis: A fixed amount supplies an independent contractual benchmark for public revenue. A low or absent aggregate does not prove nonpayment.
operational_join: Contract/project identity → legal payer → exact government/community payee → payment stream → period and currency. Company-level EITI totals cannot substitute for a project receipt.
temporal_geographic_scope: Only countries/projects with granular EITI coverage; contract effective dates, trigger, payment deadline, fiscal basis, waiver and amendment history must align.

Incomplete receipt population or confidential amount

Evidence of trigger and due date

novelty_vs_baseline: D05/N01 reconcile two accounts of money paid. This derives the expected amount from a separately established obligation.

title: Voluntary deregistration despite a contemporaneous property interest

operational_join: Exact Australian ACN as recorded/verified for the overseas proprietor → ASIC company and deregistration method → title and interest history. ABN, name similarity and registration dates are not substitutes.

Separate outstanding-liabilities evidence; no automatic net-equity substitution

ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Letter of credit/guarantee omitted from cash total
